name: codex
//: Tuned Codex CLI agent targeting the 'luna' model. Change 'model' if your codex uses a different id.
//prompt_prefix: Injected near the TOP of every issue prompt, before context reading. Edit freely.
prompt_prefix: This is the IE4727 clinic appointment portal (Theme 4). AGENTS.md at the repo root is binding and overrides the issue text. Non-negotiable rules for the base version (clinic-base/): NO AJAX, JSON-as-transport, jQuery, or any JS library; NO Bootstrap/Tailwind or any CSS framework; NO Composer, vendor/, CDNs, or PHP framework; NO 12th page beyond the eleven in docs/PAGES.md. Match the existing ie4727db schema names EXACTLY (PascalCase; single DATETIME columns SlotDateTime/appointmentDateTime; Allergies is JSON). Every DB call goes through lib/db.php q(); every echoed value through e(); every form carries csrf_field(); every protected page calls its guard first. If satisfying this issue would break any of these, STOP and comment on the issue instead of proceeding.
//prompt_suffix: Injected near the BOTTOM of every issue prompt, just before the result block. Good for reminders about verification.
prompt_suffix: Before declaring COMPLETE: run the issue's own acceptance command and `php tests/run.php`; both must be green. Write the test in the same change as the code. Do not weaken or skip tests to make a check pass.
